pkgmetadata.longdescription: Crubit's cc_bindings_from_rs tool, which generates C++ bindings for Rust crates. Chromium uses it at build time (cpp_api_from_rust in rust_static_library) and normally ships it inside its prebuilt Rust toolchain. Slotted per dev-lang/rust slot because it is a rustc driver linked against that compiler's librustc_driver.
